title: A Network Approach to Psychopathology: New Insights into Clinical Longitudinal Data
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Assumptions of stationarity and equally spaced time points may not fully hold; - Multiple testing correction may reduce statistical power; - Validation dataset had different population and measurement protocols.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data are declared available in appendices. Validation dataset used different neuroticism scales and population, which may affect generalizability.
